title: Surreal Dog and Chick
description: A surreal night scene on a cliff edge features a small man in a purple uniform and hat holding a pink heart toward a large glowing green dog made of circuit patterns and bones. A yellow chick with a pink hat stands beside a shovel. Above them floats a transparent sphere containing a tree with pink flowers and roots, set against a ringed planet, glowing city skyline, lightning bolts, and scattered animal silhouettes on a black background.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene on a rocky cliff at night. A small man in purple uniform and hat offers a glowing pink heart to a large translucent green dog composed of circuit board patterns and white bones. The dog has a spiral eye. A yellow chick wearing a pink hat stands next to a shovel. A giant transparent bubble contains a tree with pink flowers and hanging roots. In the background a large ringed planet, glowing futuristic city skyline, purple lightning bolts, and floating animal silhouettes appear against a black sky. Vibrant colors, illustrative style.
